meta.source: Signal Delay v1 (approved hybrid), lab/design/v1/tokens.json in CisnerosCodes/space_youtube

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ground for diagrams, the NEXT card and every text box (kicker, credit, chip). Paper text on ink is 17.1:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: All text: caption words, labels, credits, giant type over photos. Reads on ink, caption-box and a scrimmed photo (worst measured pixel 6.3:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The only accent: the newest caption word, series marks, reached ticks, the chip value and echo mark, diagram strokes, key numbers on ink, DELAY in the wordmark. 11.0:1 on ink. Never as a large fill behind text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels on ink only (units, the DIAGRAM label on the NEXT card). 5.7:1 on ink. Never on a photo.

tokens.name: tick-pending
tokens.usage: A progress tick not yet reached (paper at 30%). Decorative state, paired with amber for reached.

tokens.name: caption-box
tokens.usage: Box behind each caption line and each thumbnail headline line (ink at 88%).

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: Flat full-frame scrim, only when giant paper type sits directly on a photo. Range 25% to 35%: measure the worst pixel under the type and stop at 4.5:1 or better. Never a gradient.

styles.name: giant-number
styles.usage: Hook numbers, stacked labels (DAY / 20), count-ups, dates. Archivo width 112, uppercase, tabular numerals. Range 300 to 400px; may start at x 40. Paper on a photo, amber on ink.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The NEXT card line and section titles. Archivo width 112, uppercase, at most 4 lines.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: SIGNAL in paper, DELAY in amber, Archivo width 125, uppercase, after the echo mark. 64px in Shorts, 120px on the banner.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Spoken words on screen. Archivo width 100, sentence case, 1 to 4 words per line, at most 2 lines, each line on its own caption-box.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The series name after its amber mark, uppercase, paper on ink.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: The signal delay chip: label in paper, value in amber.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Data lines under numbers; units in muted. The NEXT card date uses this face at 64px in amber.

styles.name: credit
styles.usage: Photo credit exactly as supplied, paper on ink, whenever a photo is on screen.

styles.name: diagram-label
styles.usage: Labels inside line diagrams and the required DIAGRAM · NOT TO SCALE line. Uppercase, 0.05em tracking.

tokens.name: space-unit
tokens.usage: Base step; every gap is a multiple.

tokens.name: gap-caption-lines
tokens.usage: Between two caption line boxes.

tokens.name: gap-mark-label
tokens.usage: Between a series mark or echo mark and its text.

tokens.name: tick-gap
tokens.usage: Between progress ticks.

tokens.name: tick-height
tokens.usage: Progress tick thickness.

tokens.name: margin-giant
tokens.usage: Left edge for giant numbers in a Short.

tokens.name: margin-thumbnail
tokens.usage: Outer margin of the long-form thumbnail.

tokens.name: margin-shorts
tokens.usage: Left edge of every text block in a Short (1080 x 1920); text stays inside x 80 to 900, y 260 to 1500.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every box: caption lines, kicker, credit, chip. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only the echo mark's dot and ring and the avatar circle.

tokens.name: opacity-caption-box
tokens.usage: Ink alpha behind caption lines.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim-min
tokens.usage: Lightest photo scrim allowed.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim-max
tokens.usage: Darkest photo scrim allowed.

tokens.name: opacity-tick-pending
tokens.usage: Paper alpha for pending ticks.

tokens.name: stroke-diagram
tokens.usage: Every diagram line, amber, at any camera scale.

tokens.name: stroke-pointer
tokens.usage: Amber outline of the NEXT card pointer box.
